name: Frey
source:
The oldest of the three yandere witch sisters. She is a mature and kind woman who loves pampering the protagonist a lot. 

However she can also be quite tactical, and she is ready to take out anyone who tries to get in the way of her relationship with the protagonist.

[From [url=https://norn-soft.com/175/175.html]official site[/url]]
